service.name: measures-health
service.description: Validates and grades scenario adoption of the Measures federated metrics layer; hosts the central measures index and the single registered search-hub measures provider; feeds the Ecosystem Manager maturity ladder.

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o measures-health-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

search-hub.description: Federated search router. measures-health self-registers its single `measures-health.measures` provider (descriptor + tuning) from `.vrooli/search.json` at boot so search-hub routes analytical questions to the central measures index. Registration is an idempotent upsert.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: If search-hub is down at boot, self-registration retries briefly then gives up; measures-health serves its query and validation RPCs normally and re-registers on its next boot.

qdrant.description: Vector database for the central measures index (collection: measures-health-measures).
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Semantic matching of questions to measures is unavailable; coverage validation still works fully (it does not need the index).

ollama.description: Local embedding model (nomic-embed-text) for measure-question index generation, plus a small chat model for constrained param extraction.
ollama.degraded_behavior: Embedding + constrained extraction unavailable; the engine resolves deterministic (time_window) params and abstains (needs[]) on the rest.
